why: Searches found only pre-snapshot results: the best known bound is m ≤ 1.393n (Xu, 2021, improving Fulek and Pach's 1.3984n from 2017); a 2025 preprint on unavoidable patterns in dense topological graphs continues related work but does not improve the bound or resolve the conjecture. No post-January-2024 source moves the conjecture itself.
